segments.text: NOw let us see: 1. What this Rest is. 2. What these people of God, and why so called. 3. The truth of this from other Scripture Arguments. 4. Why this Rest must yet Remain. 5. Why onely to this people of God. 6. What use to make of it.

1. And though the sence of the Text includes in the word Rest, all that ease and safety which a Soul, wearyed with the burthen of sin and suffering, and pursued by Law, Wrath, and Conscience, hath with Christ in this life; the Rest of Grace: yet because it chiefly intends the Rest of eternal Glory, as the end and main part, I shall therefore confine my Discourse to this last.
